text:
maria: Quick pulse — OptKit delivery status? We need milestone check, owners, any blockers for quant recommendations / batching & caching / regression alerts. TL;DR please :eyes:

aj: PR for quant recs is up: https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/412
aj: Tests pass locally but need perf microbench on 2k seqs, still running. ETA EOD tomorrow.

samir: I'll review today. Batching changes require a small config tweak on platform: route-level batch_size override. Could be a breaking change for a few internal routes. Ping @cheng for rollout plan.

cheng: noted. Platform can add route metadata and a rollout flag. Need a migration window — prefer 1 week canary then ramp. Need a feature-flag name suggestion.

olivia: Regression alert hook is wired to evals svc; QA found a fuzz failure on quant-8bit for long-prefix prompts. Repro steps:
```
python tests/run_eval.py --model small-quant --prompt-file tests/prefix_long.txt
```
Current quant recs cause accuracy drop below threshold on that case. Proposing fallback to fp16 for long-prefix workloads.

aj: ack. I'll add fallback logic + config key `quant.fallback.long_prefix` and feature-flag it :+1:. Also adding an entry to the PR describing the fallback behavior.

maria: Owners (proposed): aj (quant recs), samir (batching + cache integration), cheng (platform rollout & flags), olivia (regression/evals). Milestones (proposed):
- PRs merged + perf bench (aj) — by 2026-04-02
- Platform config & canary (cheng) — start 2026-04-05
- Batching integration tests (samir) — by 2026-04-01
- Regression signoff (olivia) — by 2026-04-03

samir: small blocker: we need a single integration dataset from product to simulate realistic cache hit rates. @maria can you request the export from product analytics (only anonymized IDs)?

maria: on it, ticket PROD-589 created and pinged analytics. ETA data dump 2026-03-30.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging rollout at 2026-04-04 03:00 UTC. Staging link: https://staging.redwood.example/deploys/optkit-412

maria: Cool. If no major objections I'll start tracking these milestones in the delivery board and assign tasks. I'll also create the feature-flag name `optkit_quant_longprefix_fallback` unless someone objects.

olivia: thanks — I'll wire nightly evals and post results in this thread. Will also add a baseline regression test for the long-prefix case.

samir: will ping when batching PR (w/ config change) is ready for review.

aj: will add perf numbers to the PR and a short bench script at `tools/bench/optkit_bench.sh` so reviewers can reproduce.

maria: closing loop — next sync async unless a blocker pops up. Thanks everyone :shipit:
